details.description: GPT-5.6 (Sol) is the flagship model of OpenAI's GPT-5.6 family, launched July 9, 2026 as the successor to GPT-5.5; the unsuffixed 'gpt-5.6' model id routes to Sol. It is one of three GPT-5.6 tiers (Sol as flagship, Terra as a mid-tier, Luna as the cost-efficient tier) and OpenAI positioned it for coding, agentic workflows, cybersecurity, knowledge work and science, with support for tool use and computer use; OpenAI's separate 'ultra' multi-agent mode is a ChatGPT Work and Codex product feature, not an API setting. OpenAI has since launched a newer GPT-6 family (Astra, Sol, Luna) on September 22, 2026, and its current API model documentation no longer lists GPT-5.6 among its featured models; TechCrunch reports the new GPT-6 Sol makes about half as many mistakes as this model on OpenAI's internal factuality evaluation.
advantages: Reaches 80 on the Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index, the top score at publication across DeepSWE, Terminal-Bench v2 and SWE-Atlas-QnA.
Scores 71.2% on SEC-Bench Pro (cybersecurity) and 62.6% on OSWorld 2.0 (computer use), per OpenAI's launch page.
Scores 52.7% on Agents' Last Exam, a professional-workflow agentic benchmark, per OpenAI's launch page.
Supports reasoning effort from none through max via the API, letting a caller trade latency for reasoning depth, per OpenAI's model documentation.
Per Artificial Analysis, it uses fewer output tokens than GPT-5.5 on Intelligence Index tasks (15k vs 16k) while scoring higher on that benchmark.
disadvantages: Scores only 7.78% on ARC-AGI-3, a newer abstract-reasoning benchmark, per OpenAI's launch page.

Superseded by GPT-6 Sol, part of the GPT-6 family OpenAI launched September 22, 2026; TechCrunch reports GPT-6 Sol makes about half as many mistakes as this model on OpenAI's internal factuality evaluation.
Text output only; knowledge cutoff of February 16, 2026, per OpenAI's model documentation.
use_cases: Agentic coding and complex, multi-step software engineering workflows

notes: openai.com/index/gpt-5-6/ returned HTTP 403 on direct fetch; content was retrieved through a read-only fetch proxy. Confirmed via the API docs page that the unsuffixed 'gpt-5.6' id is an alias for Sol (model id gpt-5.6-sol), matching this target's uris (no '-sol' suffix, no '-terra' or '-luna'). Catalog's max_input_tokens (922,000) and max_output_tokens (128,000) match OpenAI's own published figures. Catalog carries no deprecation_date for this target and OpenAI's deprecations page lists no shutdown date for it either, even though it is no longer OpenAI's featured/recommended model.
